results.name: Ebb's storyline: observe fish, investigate the inflow at night, decide together
results.detail: The perch used to rise under the dock at dusk, seven or eight of them. Now two. I am old; maybe I count badly. Would you catch three different kinds from my pond and tell me? Not to keep. To know. >> true >> Three kinds: Perch, Bleak, Tench. So they are not gone. They are leaving. The inflow, then. Go and look at night, when the river talks louder. Take a light. >> true >> I will clear the old culvert myself. (needs 1 Plank) | Morrow knows those pipes. Let me ask it. | Let the river find its own way. It always has. | Not yet. >> Perhaps. Rivers are patient. So am I. Fewer perch this year, then. More the year after, if the river is kind. The perch rose under the dock tonight. Five of them. I counted twice. >> true >> true
